title: Phantom of the Opera
description:
S1
An acid-scarred composer (Claude Rains) rises from the Paris sewers to boost his favorite opera understudy's (Susanna Foster) career.

title: Phantom of the Opera
description:
S1
An acid-scarred composer (Herbert Lom) has his dwarf helper bring an opera singer (Heather Sears) to his London sewer hide-out.

title: Revenge of the Creature
description:
S1
Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

title: She-Wolf of London
description:
S1
Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

title: Son of Dracula
description:
S1
Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.

title: Son of Frankenstein
description:
S1
The baron's son (Basil Rathbone) revives his father's monster (Boris Karloff) with help from a broken-necked shepherd called Ygor (Bela Lugosi).

title: Sssssss
description:
S1
A snake scientist (Strother Martin) turns his daughter's (Heather Menzies) boyfriend (Dirk Benedict), his lab helper, into a big cobra.

title: Tarantula
description:
S1
Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

title: The Thing
description:
S1
An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World.".
